physical_host.machine: Framework Desktop (AMD Ryzen AI Max 300 Series)

correctness_scopes.production_baseline: Prefill 80/80 exact with MTP disengaged; true AR 80/80 self-exact; explicit MTP C1-C4/C6-C8 70/70 passes. Production C5 subgroup route fails 10/10 mtp_self_exact and remains correctness-ineligible.
correctness_scopes.operation_attribution: C7/C8 profiler cells pass. C5 reproduces the production subgroup correctness failure and is attribution-only.
correctness_scopes.launch_ledger: Run-owned cap-eight R16/R24/R32 warm/profile cells all pass exactness, equality, engagement, and budget checks.
correctness_scopes.k1_reconciliation: Current production C6/C8 K1 full suite passes 20/20 exactness, equality, engagement, and budget checks.
correctness_scopes.pass_budget_route: Run-owned one-group C5-C8 K3 full suite passes 40/40 exactness, equality, engagement, and budget checks; this route override is diagnostic and production remains width-4 fail-closed.

measured_results.baseline_open_fact: Production C5 splits 4+1 and fails self-exactness; no C5 throughput result is claim-eligible.
measured_results.grouped_c2: Every C2 prompt shares one grouped tick. Current grouped server throughput is 178.660 prompt tok/s; 211.888 requires 15.68% aggregate wall reduction and per-prompt 330.4-632.4 ms ticks.
measured_results.launch_granularity: R16/R24/R32 Q4/Q5/Q6 launches are bound by exact owner, kernel, grid, workgroup, count, and per-launch timing in the ledger.
measured_results.cycle_residual: After matched prefill and named stages, C6/C8 K1 residual is 50.7/58.4 ms/cycle. Physical-group entry excess explains it within 1.8/2.8 ms/cycle; proposal gaps, DMA, and an untraced GPU family do not.
measured_results.pass_budget: External-parity target-only pass budget is zero at C5/R20-C8/R32. Even with residual removed and target time set to zero, non-target deficits are 135/198/339/412 ms/cycle.

decisions: Z0 provides the same-host current-head denominator and all requested attribution/budget evidence.
No retained performance candidate or public number changed, so benchmarks/README.md and benchmarks/CHANGELOG.md are intentionally unchanged.
Automatic serving remains the production width-4 fail-closed route.
Wide-MTP Z2 must start from accept/non-target external differential; target-only A/B/E work cannot enter until a measured non-target mechanism creates positive pass slack.
C2 Z1 starts from grouped rows70-134 and the published 211.888 prompt-token/s tick budgets.
next: Begin Z1/Z2 external differential. Preserve production C5 correctness failure as a blocker and compare wide accept/non-target dataflow before target kernels.
